# Impermanence damage endpoints

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Thunder Spike
- **Mechanic tags:** damage-pool, conversion, methodology

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Canonical SS13 Goddess of Hunting Impermanence changes Physical and generic damage endpoints independently. The engine applies Physical endpoint bonuses to converted Physical packets, and generic endpoint bonuses once per packet. In-game endpoint, Lucky roll, and mixed-damage measurements remain open. To verify, keep the same weapon, skill, supports, enemy, and conditions. Record the Physical and Lightning damage ranges with Impermanence off and on. Repeat with native Lightning added damage and with Lucky damage. Remove temporary damage buffs and record Numbed uptime separately when testing Thunder Spike. A lower minimum is intended; average DPS depends on the damage mix and roll mechanics.
